title: playstore-release config
description: Per-app Google Play listing content. Credentials are NOT here — they come from the environment (PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: a path, inline JSON or base64) and the package name from PLAY_PACKAGE_NAME or config.packageName. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory. Keys under `console` are never sent to the API: they only feed the checklist of steps Google exposes in the Play Console alone.

packageName.description: Android application id, e.g. com.example.app. PLAY_PACKAGE_NAME overrides it.

defaultLanguage.description: The Play language this config's shared listing is written in, as Play spells it: en-US, tr-TR, de-DE, es-419.

listing.description: The listing for defaultLanguage, and the default for every entry in `locales`. Fields shared across languages belong here so they are written once.

locales.description: Listings keyed by Play language code. Each entry overrides `listing`; anything it omits is inherited. Omit for a single-language app.

details.description: Store settings → Contact details. contactEmail is required by Play before a listing can go live.

bundle.description: Where the signed .aab lives. `path` names one file; `dir` means the newest *.aab in that directory. Omit when CI uploads bundles itself.

mapping.description: Optional ProGuard/R8 mapping.txt to upload as the deobfuscation file.

images.description: Store graphics. `dir` is the base: icon.png, feature-graphic.png, phone/, tablet-7/, tablet-10/ inside it are the defaults; each key below overrides one. A language subdirectory (phone/tr-TR/) overrides the base for that language.

icon.description: 512×512 32-bit PNG. Alpha is allowed here (unlike the App Store).

featureGraphic.description: 1024×500 JPEG or 24-bit PNG, no alpha. Required by Play.

phoneScreenshots.description: Directory: 2–8 JPEG/PNG, each side 320–3840 px, long side at most 2× the short side.

release.description: Where and how the uploaded bundle is released by `publish`. Production promotion is a separate, irreversible operation (`promote`).

track.description: internal, alpha (closed testing), beta (open testing), production, or the name of a custom closed track.

status.description: completed = live for everyone on the track; inProgress = staged (needs userFraction); draft = uploaded, not served.

userFraction.description: Staged rollout share, strictly between 0 and 1. Only valid with status inProgress.

changesNotSentForReview.description: Commit the edit without sending it for review. Only meaningful for an app that has already passed review once.

name.description: Release name shown in the Console; defaults to the versionName.

testers.description: Google Groups (email addresses) allowed on each testing track.

dataSafety.description: The Data safety questionnaire as the CSV the Play Console exports. Filled in once in the Console, exported, and re-applied by the API on every later release.

subscriptions.description: Omit when the app sells nothing. Each entry is created or updated, then its base plan activated.

console.description: Answers to the Play Console forms Google exposes no API for. Never sent anywhere; rendered into the checklist and references/console.md so a person or a browser agent can fill them in. `done` records which steps are finished.

developerId.description: The developer id from the Play Console URL, to render deep links.

appId.description: The app's numeric id from the Play Console URL, to render deep links.

category.description: Store settings → App category, e.g. Business, Productivity, Finance.

pricing.description: Free cannot be changed to paid later.

countries.description: "all", or a list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.

restricted.description: true when parts of the app need a login.

password.description: Keep this config out of git if you fill it in.

contentRating.description: Free-form answers for the IARC questionnaire, echoed into the checklist (email, category, violence, sexuality, language, controlled substances, gambling, user interaction, personal info, location …).

targetAudience.description: Age groups, e.g. ["18+"]. Anything under 13 triggers the Families policy.

financialFeatures.description: Declared financial features, or [] for none. A POS/payments app must answer this form truthfully.

done.description: Console step keys already completed — see `playstore-release check` for the keys.

releaseNotes.description: What's new for this language, 500 characters. Written by `release`.

billingPeriod.description: ISO 8601: P1W, P1M, P3M, P6M, P1Y.

prices.description: Keyed by region code. Everything not listed is derived from the first region by Play.
